description:
**What:** Create tests/principal_query.rs with 4 async wiremock tests. Oracle: RFC 9670 §2.4.1 filter fields, §2.5 queryChanges; RFC 8620 §5.5, §5.6.

**Tests:**
1. principal_query_no_filter: assert resp.ids.len() == 2; assert request has no filter key.
2. principal_query_with_filter: pass {"name":"Joe","type":"individual"}; assert request body has filter.name == "Joe" and filter.type == "individual" (oracle: RFC 9670 §2.4.1).
3. principal_query_changes_round_trip: assert resp.old_query_state, new_query_state, removed, added[0].index.
4. principal_query_changes_with_max_changes: assert maxChanges appears in request.

**Acceptance criteria:** All 4 tests pass.
title: Wiremock tests: Principal/query and Principal/queryChanges
